text:
Maya: Hey people ops — quick logistics Q while I'm on parental leave. I'm traveling home (India) for 45 days in July. Do I need to pause benefits or notify payroll about crossing borders? Also curious if I can have my nursing pump shipped to family address there or if that's a restricted item.

Sam (People Ops): Congrats Maya! For a 45-day temporary stay, benefits typically continue. We need a Temporary Address Form and passport copy. Please upload by 2026-06-10. Payroll: usually stays on US payroll for <183 days but fill international payroll form so we can confirm. Pump shipments are generally fine but IT/shipping won't handle personal medical devices; recommend using a trusted courier and keep receipts.

Ravi (Benefits): Adding — health plan covers emergency care abroad but elective/local treatments might not be. We'll send an acknowledgment to sign noting exceptions. If your leave becomes >90 days we may need to switch plans.

Nora (Payroll): For payroll we need the dates, address, and to know if you'll be doing any local contracting. If not, withholding remains. Submit the payroll checklist by 2026-06-10 to avoid manual adjustments.

Alex (Manager): I'll approve the leave and coverage. Maya, please add a short handoff doc and set your Slack status. Priya will cover critical tasks for Weeks 1-6.

it-bot: Reminder: international shipping policy prohibits company-paid shipment of personal medical devices.

Maya: Thanks all — filling forms today and will arrange pump shipping privately. Uploaded temporary address to the form and pinged Priya about coverage. Appreciate the quick replies.
